review.imagery: Root visually reviewed all four original full-resolution Eagle Hills resources observed in the exact Abu Dhabi project page. Three mansion/estate exterior renders and one island overview preserve the separate private residence and resort context. Country-navigation media and the project wordmark were excluded. Private residence interiors were not verified, so no interior scenes were substituted.
review.floorPlans: Current normal-GET developer, announcement, operator and mansion pages were reviewed for public drawing documents. Targeted public searches and the existing excluded portal PDF evidence were reconciled. The portal brochure identifies Dubai/Jumeira Bay and remains excluded from Abu Dhabi. Public broker floor-plan controls provide enquiry forms. No form was submitted or access restriction bypassed. Zero verified residential drawings are recorded, with an explicit dated on-page availability section and original developer/operator source links.
review.location: The reviewed official material establishes only a private island off Abu Dhabi Corniche and planned bridge/sea access. No precise surveyed entrance, genuine regional map, source-confirmed journey time or kilometre route was established. The aerial is scoped as a proposed island render within the gallery. Project-name directions preserve the genuine location limitation.
review.provenance: Four original project image URLs, current developer/operator HTML and source bytes retain dated SHA256 receipts. The source-specific render masters are unchanged. Protected identity, prior text research, commercial qualifications and source conflicts are preserved.

unavailable: Verified Abu Dhabi residential floor plans, a public original plan PDF, confirmed private residence interiors, exact visitor entrance, surveyed coordinates, regional connectivity map and reliable destination times or distances remain unavailable in reviewed sources.
